card.name: Just before a rank or title
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or partial rank words right before a military rank or academic title and name, such as 'of', 'to', 'by' or a comma. Seen mostly in biographical history text about officers.

modes.label: Promotion or rank link

modes.label: Inside a rank word
modes.description: A partial or abbreviated rank, where the rest of the rank comes next.
modes.example: being promoted to bre<<vet>> major on 31 March

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing a title such as Professor, Dr or Prof next.
card.plain: It fires at the spot where a rank or title like General or Dr. is about to be written.
